span.normalized: In December 2022, a subsidiary of Transocean Ltd. commenced an arbitration proceeding against us alleging breach of a license agreement related to certain dual-activity drilling patents. In July 2025, the arbitration tribunal rendered a final decision awarding Transocean Ltd. $7.9 million in damages, including interest, and awarded Valaris $7.4 million as reimbursement for legal fees incurred in connection with this matter.
span.raw: In December 2022, a subsidiary of Transocean Ltd. commenced an arbitration proceeding against us alleging breach of a license agreement related to certain dual-activity drilling patents. In July 2025, the arbitration tribunal rendered a final decision awarding Transocean Ltd. $7.9 million in damages, including interest, and awarded Valaris $7.4 million as reimbursement for legal fees incurred in connection with this matter.
